II. Application 
Application procedure 
All application documents must be submitted before the  
deadline. Documents can be sent by email with PDF  
files as we do not need original copies. 
Required documents for application 
1. Application form(with a photo attached) (pdf) 
2. Certification of Enrollment (pdf) 
3. Certification of Transcript (pdf) 
4. A photocopy of passport (pdf) 
5. Proof of English Proficiency for those whose first 
language is not English and would like to take 
courses in English in DAU 
  (TOEIC 700 or above, TOEFL iBT 70 or above, 
IELTS 5.5 or above) 
6. 1 Photo(jpg) 
7. Certificate of Insurance(pdf) from home  
  country(recommended) 
*for those who get insurance in his/her own country 
8. Certificate of health including Tuberculosis 
(pdf) (recommended) 
*Inspections for Tuberculosis must be done in hospitals 
appointed by hospitals in provinces appointed by the 
Korean embassy 
Deadline for Nomination/Application 
Nomination Application 
2026 May 1 2026 Jun 6 
2026 Nov 1 2026 Dec 6 
Suggested length of study for exchange One Semester or One Year 
Number of exchange students allowed 
(Semester and Yearly) 
According to agreement 
Suggested level of language proficiency for 
exchange program 
 None 
Estimated time to deliver acceptance letter 
Spring Semester Fall Semester 
Mid. December Mid. June 
Procedure of applying for student visa 
Acceptance letter can be used as a supporting 
document for your visa and you can take it to the 
nearest Korean Embassy.

3 / 4 
III. Course Information  
Course list (if online list is unavailable, 
please mail coordinator) http://english.donga.ac.kr/ 
Do you offer English-Taught Courses? 
List available? Refer to attached file (excel files) 
Any limitation or suggestion on course 
selection? 
A certain level of Korean Language Proficiency is required 
for the better course selections. 
Preliminary language training classes 
provided? 
http://global.donga.ac.kr/ 
(For exchange students, Korean language is optional) 
Necessary pay to preliminary language 
training class? 
Free for Exchange Students 
(4hours/a day, from Monday to Friday) 
 
IV. Scholarship 
Any scholarship provided to exchange 
program? 
There will be no scholarship provided to the exchange 
students 
 
V. Accommodation 
Type of accommodation offered?   Two students in one room 
Fees of on-campus dormitory 
- Seunghak Campus [(amount for a semester(4 months)] 
·Male students(New dorm) : approx. 950,000 KRW  
·Female students(Old dorm) : approx. 900,000 KRW 
Off-campus housing assistance is 
provided? 
No 
Maximum beds offered to every 
partner school? 
Yes 
Any limitation or suggestion on 
accommodation? 
Dormitory is allocated by Office of International Affairs 
 
VI. Expense (in local currency) 
Insurance 
Students will be required to have Korean National Health 
Insurance. This will cost about 
55,000KRW~70,000KRW/month starting from 
April/October  
Students should have personal international insurance that 
can cover the students’ medical fee in Korea from the date of 
arrival until the end of March/September 
Meal Approx.. 6,500KRW~8,000KRW/lunch in university 
Public Transport 60,000KW/month(estimated)
